name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: Earn all other 54 trophies in GTA VI singleplayer to unlock the platinum, since no multiplayer and no DLC trophies are required [1][2]. The list totals 55 trophies - 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze - and 28 of them stay hidden on PSN until earned [1][2]. PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, while PlayStationTrophies rates it 7/10 mainly because of the drone time trials [1][4]. PlayHub maps the same list onto the 100% completion requirements [5].
steps: Finish the story once and keep manual saves at the start and end of each chapter, because the game has no mission replay [1].
Clear the 100% completion checklist, the single biggest requirement, then mop up the Strangers and Freaks strands [1][5].
Bank the one potentially missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude's Chapter 1 meditation, during the story run [1].
The platinum pops automatically the moment the last of the 54 trophies lands [1][3].

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Play Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and the trophy unlocks automatically in the mission's closing moments [1][2]. It is the first trophy of the run and cannot be missed with natural story progress [3][4]. The official trophy page confirms it as the opener of the story set [5].
steps: Start a new game and play Gone Fishing from the opening scene, following the mission prompts [2].
Do not skip cutscenes; the trophy fires in the scripted end-of-mission sequence [3].
Nothing to farm - the trophy is story-guaranteed [1][4].

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Complete Chapter 1 and the trophy pops, since it is an automatic story trophy that cannot be missed [1][3]. PowerPyx ties the unlock to the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, which is the hand-off after the Chapter 1 finale [1][2]. Mobalytics adds that several optional Chapter 1 tasks should be picked up before the chapter closes [3].
steps: Play every Chapter 1 mission in order from Gone Fishing to the chapter finale [2][3].
Carry on into Chapter 2's opener What's in the Bag?, the moment PowerPyx pegs to the unlock [1][2].
Clean up the Chapter 1 exclusive optional tasks before moving on, since they never come back [3].

Do not enable cheats, since cheats disable trophies and saving [1].

name: Break the Bank

The chapter lists the full build-up - scoping the bank, the security expert, the practice safe and the explosives prep - before the heist itself fires [3].
steps: Advance Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist prep missions unlock [3].
Finish the prep chain - scope the bank, security expert, safe word, hidden charges [2][3].
Run the heist itself; the trophy pops with the mission [1][2].

name: A Long Road
guide: Reach 100% completion through the pause-menu checklist, which only becomes viewable after the story [1][2]. The requirements are lenient - roughly 60% of true completion - and nothing toward the checklist is missable [1][2]. The big chunks are any 70 of 80 challenges, all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, 15 of 15 Target Decks, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied [2][3].
steps: Finish the story first, since the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion only after the credits [1][2].
Work the checklist in chunks: robberies, gang operations, challenges, scans and studies [2][3].
Nothing is missable, so leave the cleanup for free-roam [1].
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100% [1][4].
